title: UPS Sales 2027 Internship
description:
Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

UPS is seeking highly motivated junior and senior undergraduate students, along with recent graduates, to join our 11-week 2027 Sales Summer Internship Program. The U.S. Sales team is responsible for winning new international & domestic small package volume and growing our current book of business by leveraging our business/supply chain acumen and internal support functions.

The Sales Intern will work alongside local members of our U.S. Sales teams to help win new business. This internship program provides an excellent learning environment, and UPS is seeking talented interns who are excited to learn new skills and aren't afraid to tackle big projects. With access to leadership staff and mentors, the interns will have a meaningful and supportive experience.

Responsibilities

Utilizes general sales and negotiation skills; prospecting/developing warm leads for international/domestic small package revenue on behalf of UPS and assisting along the sales cycle with current UPS account managers and teams
Works with cross-functional teams including operations, solutions engineers, marketing, and UPS leadership to dynamically solve customer challenges
Learns how to use a consultative sales approach to evaluate a customer’s supply chain to find opportunities to present UPS solutions and insights that supports their business goals

Preferences

Possesses ability to communicate with all levels of management, multitask and work with cross functional teams
Displays leadership attributes within classroom, projects, and/or volunteering
Demonstrates excellent communication (verbal and written) skills, and crafts compelling storyline
Possesses basic knowledge of Microsoft (Excel and PowerPoint) and builds presentations incorporating data visualizations/insights
Aspires for a career in sales – Highly Preferred
Recent graduate or pursuing a degree in Business Management, Finance, Logistics, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, International Business, or Psychology – Preferred

Basic Qualifications

Must be a U.S. Citizen or National of the U.S., an alien lawfully admitted for permanent residence, or an alien authorized to work in the U.S. for this employer
Employer will not sponsor a visa for this or future positions
Must be currently located in the same geographic location as the job or willing to relocate yourself
A rising junior, senior, or recent graduate within the last 24 months
Must have a mode for transportation

Other Criteria

Employers will not sponsor visas for positions.
